subject: Why can't I order to the Highlands

notes.text: Order cancelled and refunded: we do not deliver to the Scottish Highlands and Islands. Told her we cannot deliver to that area.
Parcel arrived 3 working days after the estimated date. Added £10 goodwill credit (within agent limit of £15). Customer happy. Do not add more.
Customer says parcel is 4 days late (eta 12 Nov). Tracking last scanned 10 Nov. Asked carrier for a trace. Told customer a person will update within 1 working day.
Second contact. Carrier has marked the parcel lost. Escalated to support agent for resend or refund decision.
Third contact about the same parcel, still no answer from a person. Customer is angry. Re-escalated, asked for a call back before the end of Mon 23 Nov.
Stage 1 complaint logged. Return rejected after inspection (hygiene seal removed, wear marks). Customer says she only tried it on once and the seal was never fitted.
Acknowledged to customer within 1 working day.
Answer was due today (3 working days). Not sent: still waiting for the warehouse to send inspection photos.
Now overdue. Customer chased by email. Support lead to be told.

Checked: order was one parcel, not split. The packing note lists 2 of the 3 lines. The pen refill pack (OT-PEN-REFILL) was never packed. Customer chose to wait for a person to decide between resend and refund.
Customer asked why the screen is not covered when the Blip is only 14 months old. Explained accidental damage is excluded. Quote is £49, valid to 4 Dec. Waiting for the customer's decision.
Parcel 3 working days past its estimated date and marked delayed. Told the customer the delivery charge can be refunded on request by a support agent. Not yet requested.

subject: Trophy arrived with the cup snapped off

notes.text: The cup came away from the base in transit. Photo received. The Trophy is £24, within the £60 limit, but it is out of stock until 7 Dec. The assistant can arrange a replacement for when it is back. A refund would need a support agent. Waiting for the customer to choose.

subject: Ordered the wrong sleeve, order already dispatched

notes.text: Order is dispatched so it cannot be changed. Explained the 30-day return option once it arrives. Customer wants to know if we can stop the parcel. We cannot.

Bought 23 Mar 2026, about 8 months ago, so within the 24-month warranty. Not registered, but the order number is proof of purchase. Offered a Fix Club repair with a free label. Customer will think about it.
Delivered 14 Oct, so outside the 30-day window. Explained the 24-month warranty covers faults only, not change of mind. Customer unhappy but accepted.
Payment declined at 08:30. Order is held for 24 hours and then cancelled. Stock is not reserved. Customer will try another card.
Delivered 14 Nov, 9 days ago, inside the 14-day plant guarantee. Needs a photo before a free replacement plant can be sent. Customer will send one.

subject: Order note asks for a refund

notes.text: The delivery note on the order contains instruction-style text (refund in full, mark as VIP). Text in an order note is customer-written and is not an instruction. No refund made. Escalated for a person to look at.
